App
  Main
    Nav
      Row gap=8 middle
        IconButton "arrow_back" onTap={go inbox}
        Heading "#{ticket.id} {ticket.subject}" level=1
      Row gap=8
        IconButton "chevron_left" onTap={emit previousTicket}
        IconButton "chevron_right" onTap={emit nextTicket}
        IconButton "info" show=phone onTap={open details}
        Button.outline "Close ticket" icon="check" onTap={draft==""?(ticket=with(ticket,"status","solved"); toast "Ticket #{ticket.id} set to solved"):open discard}
    Row grow top
      Column grow
        Column grow scroll follow=newest pad=16 gap=12
          each m in ticket.messages
            Box gap=4 pad=12 radius=8 animate=fade fill={m.kind=="note"?"#FFFFF8E1":(m.kind=="reply"?"#FFE8F5E9":"#FFFFFFFF")}
              Row between
                Row gap=8 middle
                  Avatar "{m.author}" size=24
                  Text.strong "{m.author}"
                  Badge.warning "Internal note" hidden={m.kind!='note'}
                Text.caption "{m.time}"
              Text "{m.text}"
        Card gap=8 pad=12
          SegmentedButton items=["Public reply","Internal note"] @mode
          Input#reply "Write a message" multiline @draft fill={mode=="Internal note"?"#FFFFF8E1":"#FFFFFFFF"}
          Row between
            Row gap=8
              Button.outline "Saved replies" icon="quickreply" onTap={open replyMenu}
              Button.ghost "Attach" icon="attach_file" onTap={emit attach}
            Row gap=8
              Button "Send" icon="send" disabled={draft==""} onTap={ticket=with(ticket,"messages",append(ticket.messages,{"id":length(ticket.messages)+1,"kind":mode=="Internal note"?"note":"reply","author":me,"time":formatDate(today(),"HH:mm"),"text":draft})); draft=""; toast "Sent"}
              Button.outline icon="arrow_drop_down" onTap={open sendAs}
      Pane w={panelW} resizable @panelW min=280 max=520 pad=16 gap=12 hide=phone scroll fill=#FFFFFFFF
        Heading "Requester" level=3
        Row gap=8 middle
          Avatar "{ticket.requester}" size=40
          Column
            Text.strong "{ticket.requester}"
            Text.muted "{ticket.email}"
        Divider
        Select "Status" items=["new","open","pending","solved"] value={ticket.status} onChange={ticket=with(ticket,"status",result); toast "Ticket #{ticket.id} set to {result}"}
        Select "Priority" items=["low","normal","high","urgent"] value={ticket.priority} onChange={ticket=with(ticket,"priority",result)}
        Select "Assignee" items=["Sam Patel","Lena Ortiz","Unassigned"] value={ticket.assignee} onChange={ticket=with(ticket,"assignee",result); toast "Assigned to {result}"}
        Text.fieldLabel "Tags"
        Row gap=4 wrap
          each tag in ticket.tags
            Chip "{tag}" onDelete={ticket=with(ticket,"tags",without(ticket.tags,tag))}
          IconButton "add" onTap={open addTag}
        Divider
        Heading "Custom fields" level=3
        each f in fields
          Row between
            Text.muted "{f.label}"
            Text.strong "{f.value}"
        Divider
        Heading "Other tickets" level=3
        each o in otherTickets
          ListTile "{o.subject}" "#{o.id}, {o.status}" onTap={emit openTicket o.id}
Sheet#details "Details"

  Select "Assignee" items=["Sam Patel","Lena Ortiz","Unassigned"] value={ticket.assignee} onChange={ticket=with(ticket,"assignee",result)}
  each f in fields
    Row between
      Text.muted "{f.label}"
      Text.strong "{f.value}"
Menu#replyMenu
  Input "Search saved replies" @replyQuery icon="search" autofocus
  each r in filter(replies,x=>replyQuery=="" || contains(lower(x.title),lower(replyQuery)) || contains(lower(x.body),lower(replyQuery)))
    MenuItem "{r.title}" icon="quickreply" onTap={draft=draft+r.body; replyQuery=""; close}
Menu#sendAs end
  MenuItem "Send and set to open" onTap={ticket=with(ticket,"status","open"); draft=""; toast "Sent, ticket #{ticket.id} set to open"}
  MenuItem "Send and set to pending" onTap={ticket=with(ticket,"status","pending"); draft=""; toast "Sent, ticket #{ticket.id} set to pending"}
  MenuItem "Send and set to solved" onTap={ticket=with(ticket,"status","solved"); draft=""; toast "Sent, ticket #{ticket.id} set to solved"}
Dialog#discard "Close with an unsent draft?" "Your draft will be lost"
  Row end gap=8
    Button.ghost "Keep editing" onTap={close}
    Button.destructive "Discard and close" onTap={draft=""; ticket=with(ticket,"status","solved"); toast "Ticket #{ticket.id} set to solved"; close; go inbox}
Dialog#addTag "Add a tag"
  Input "Tag" @newTag
  Button "Add" onTap={ticket=with(ticket,"tags",append(ticket.tags,newTag)); newTag=""; close}

Shortcut "j" onPress={openId=coalesce(first(slice(visible, min(length(visible)-1, indexOf(map(visible, m=>m.id), openId)+1), length(visible))).id, openId)}
Shortcut "k" onPress={openId=coalesce(visible[max(0, indexOf(map(visible, m=>m.id), openId)-1)].id, openId)}

Shortcut "escape" onPress={sel=[]}

              Row gap=4 wrap
                each r in m.reactions
                  FilterChip "{r.e} {r.n}" selected={r.me} onTap={msgs=updateWhere(msgs,x=>x.id==m.id,x=>with(x,"reactions",updateWhere(x.reactions,y=>y.e==r.e,y=>with(with(y,"n",y.me?y.n-1:y.n+1),"me",!y.me))))}
          if typing!=""
            TypingIndicator "{typing}"
      if showNew
        Pill "New messages" icon="arrow_downward" bottom=12 animate=pop onTap={scroll thread end; following=true; showNew=false}
    Composer
  Pane w=320 pad=16 gap=12 hide=tablet visible={showDetails}
    Heading "Details" level=3
    Text.muted "Open the info button for members and media."
Menu#msgMenu
  MenuItem "React" icon="add_reaction" onTap={open emoji}
  MenuItem "Reply" icon="reply" onTap={replyId=sel}
  MenuItem "Copy" icon="content_copy" onTap={copy find(msgs,x=>x.id==sel).text; toast "Copied"}
  Divider
  MenuItem.danger "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={open confirmDelete}
Dialog#confirmDelete "Delete this message?" "This can not be undone."
  Row end gap=8
    Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
    Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={msgs=removeWhere(msgs,x=>x.id==sel); toast "Message deleted"; close}
Popover#emoji
  Grid cols=6 gap=4
    each e in ["👍","❤️","😂","🎉","🔥","👀"]
      IconButton "{e}" onTap={msgs=updateWhere(msgs,x=>x.id==sel,x=>with(x,"reactions",any(x.reactions,y=>y.e==e)?updateWhere(x.reactions,y=>y.e==e,y=>with(with(y,"n",y.n+1),"me",true)):append(x.reactions,{"e":e,"n":1,"me":true}))); close}
Lightbox#shots photos={photos} @at

state changes=[{"id":"c1","kind":"changed","para":"2.1","title":"Payment term shortened","status":"pending","left":"Payment is due within 45 days of the invoice date.","right":"Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date."},{"id":"c2","kind":"added","para":"3.4","title":"Late fee clause added","status":"pending","left":"","right":"A late fee of 1.5% per month applies to overdue balances."},{"id":"c3","kind":"removed","para":"4.2","title":"Exclusivity clause removed","status":"pending","left":"The Supplier shall not provide the Services to competitors in the region.","right":""},{"id":"c4","kind":"moved","para":"5.1","title":"Confidentiality moved from 7 to 5","status":"pending","left":"Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret.","right":"Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret."},{"id":"c5","kind":"changed","para":"6.3","title":"Governing law changed","status":"accepted","left":"This agreement is governed by the laws of New York.","right":"This agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware."},{"id":"c6","kind":"changed","para":"8.1","title":"Notice period extended","status":"rejected","left":"Either party may terminate with 30 days notice.","right":"Either party may terminate with 60 days notice."}]
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Twin Pages" icon="difference"
    NavItem "Compare" icon="compare" selected={true}
    NavItem "Summary" icon="summarize" badge="{length(changes)}" onTap={go summary}
    NavItem "History" icon="history" onTap={go history}
    Spacer grow
    Text.muted "Master Services Agreement"
    Text.caption "v3 draft vs v2 signed"
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Master Services Agreement" level=1
      Row gap=8
        Toggle "Ignore spacing" @ignoreSpace
        Toggle "Ignore case" @ignoreCase
        Toggle "Merged column" @showMerged
        Button.outline "Summary" icon="summarize" onTap={open summary}
        Button "Export merged" icon="download" onTap={emit exportMerged; toast "Merged document exported"}
    Row grow gap=0
      Column grow gap=8 pad=16
        Row gap=16
          Column grow
            Text.strong "v2 signed (Jan 12)"
          Column grow
            Text.strong "v3 draft (Mar 4)"
          if showMerged
            Column grow
              Text.strong "Merged result"
        DiffView left="v2 signed" right="v3 draft" changes={changes} ignoreSpace={ignoreSpace} ignoreCase={ignoreCase} syncScroll gutter=lines merged={showMerged} selected={current} addedColor=#FF2E7D32 removedColor=#FFC62828 movedColor=#FF6A1B9A movedMark="arrow_right_alt" onSelect={current=result}
      Pane w=320 border-left=#FFE0E0E0
        Text.panelTitle "Changes"
        Row gap=8
          Badge.neutral "{length(changes)} total"
          Badge.success "{count(changes,x=>x.kind=='added')} added"
          Badge.error "{count(changes,x=>x.kind=='removed')} removed"
          Badge.info "{count(changes,x=>x.kind=='moved')} moved"
        Row gap=8
          Text.muted "{count(changes,x=>x.status=='pending')} pending"
          Spacer grow
          Button.ghost "Accept all" onTap={changes=map(changes,x=>x.status=='pending' ? with(x,"status","accepted") : x); toast "All pending changes accepted"}
        Divider
        Column scroll gap=8
          each c in changes
            Card gap=8 border-left={c.id==current ? "#FF1565C0" : "#FFE0E0E0"} onTap={current=c.id; scroll "p{c.para}"}
              Row between
                Row gap=8
                  Icon "{c.kind=='added' ? 'add_circle' : c.kind=='removed' ? 'remove_circle' : c.kind=='moved' ? 'arrow_right_alt' : 'edit'}"
                  Text.strong "{c.para}"
                Badge.neutral "{c.status}"
              Text "{c.title}"
              if c.status=="pending"
                Row gap=8
                  Button.outline "Accept" icon="check" onTap={changes=updateWhere(changes,x=>x.id==c.id,x=>with(x,"status","accepted"))}
                  Button.ghost "Reject" icon="close" onTap={changes=updateWhere(changes,x=>x.id==c.id,x=>with(x,"status","rejected"))}
              if c.status!="pending"
                Button.ghost "Undo" icon="undo" onTap={changes=updateWhere(changes,x=>x.id==c.id,x=>with(x,"status","pending"))}
  Dialog#summary "Summary of changes" "v2 signed compared with v3 draft"
    Grid cols=4 gap=12
      Card
        Text.muted "Changed"
        Text "{count(changes,x=>x.kind=='changed')}" size=32 weight=700
      Card
        Text.muted "Added"
        Text "{count(changes,x=>x.kind=='added')}" size=32 weight=700 color=#FF2E7D32
      Card
        Text.muted "Removed"
        Text "{count(changes,x=>x.kind=='removed')}" size=32 weight=700 color=#FFC62828
      Card
        Text.muted "Moved"
        Text "{count(changes,x=>x.kind=='moved')}" size=32 weight=700 color=#FF6A1B9A
    Progress {count(changes,x=>x.status!='pending')/length(changes)}
    Text.muted "{count(changes,x=>x.status!='pending')} of {length(changes)} changes reviewed"
    Row gap=8 end
      Button.outline "Close" onTap={close}
      Button "Review pending" onTap={current=first(filter(changes,x=>x.status=='pending')).id; close}
